title: EnergySystems LoadForecastCSV

stats.done_summary:
Completed the annual load forecast and reliability analysis for the 15-minute load series (January 1–7, 2026). Key deliverables:

**Analysis code:** `code/analysis.py` — full pipeline including data loading, cleaning, feature engineering, forecasting, and visualization.

**Outputs:** 4 CSV files in `outputs/` (cleaned data, daily summary, hourly profile, monthly forecast).

**Figures (6 PNG files in `report/images/`):**
- fig1_time_series.png — Full time series with missing data highlighted and rolling mean
- fig2_daily_profiles.png — Daily load profiles by day type + hourly box plots
- fig3_load_duration.png — Load duration curve + frequency histogram
- fig4_annual_forecast.png — Monthly energy and peak demand forecast with reserve margins
- fig5_heatmap.png — Hour × day-of-week load heatmap
- fig6_daily_summary.png — Daily energy and peak demand bar charts

**Report:** `report/report.md` — comprehensive 7-section report covering:
1. Data overview (672 records, 17.9% missing, linear interpolation applied)
2. Load profile analysis (flat diurnal shape, 89.4% load factor)
3. Daily energy/peak summary (peak: 133.6 MW, weekly energy: 20,064 MWh)
4. Annual forecast (1,003–1,043 GWh; monthly breakdown with seasonal factors)
5. Reliability analysis (load duration curve, percentile thresholds, reserve margins)
6. Reliability commentary (data gap risk, capacity requirements: 153.6–161.3 MW at 15–20% reserve)
7. Conclusions and methodology appendix
